4 September 2026
Oxford Nanopore Technologies plc (the "Company")
Director/PDMR Notification
Notification and public disclosure of transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities and persons closely associated with them
The Company has been notified that, on 4 September 2026, Nicholas Keher, Chief Financial Officer of the Company and a Person Discharging Managerial Responsibilities, purchased a total of 15,325 ordinary shares in the Company at a price of £1.622648 per share.
This announcement is made pursuant to the Company's obligations under Article 19(3) of the UK Market Abuse Regulation.
